decision.reason: [ev-782350fea3b9] only says "Drop Env Vars for v1" and links PR #6576. It does not name the environment variables that were removed or the component that read them. It also does not say whether anything replaces them or what happens to a deployment that still sets them (for example, they are silently ignored or startup fails). None of the other items in the Features section describe these variables, and no upgrade-guide section is shown. To write the subject, applicability and consequence, we need the PR #6576 diff or the v1 upgrade guide's list of removed env vars.
